Ray-AABB (Axis Aligned Bounding Box) intersection. · GitHub
Here's a simplified/optimised version in TypeScript that I'm pretty sure is equivalent to OP. Math.min () and Math.max () operators handle Infinity and -Infinity correctly so it works for axis-aligned rays. ... You can calculate the intersection point as rayOrigin + tNear * rayDir if you need that.
